INSTRUMENT.why_the_gate_uses_the_paired_sign_test: throughput and decisions per game are identical within replicate pairs, yet 11 of 12 differing games moved the same way in one pair; totals inherit that session-level component, per-game signs are the sharper statistic. Both promotions in this project's history (context window 11/3, Flash-Next in keithtyser's harness 11/3) were sign-test results.

MECHANISM_GATE_checked_first.1_model_loaded: vllm-openai-server.log reports 'Model loading took' between 78 and 86 GiB and the served model name Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4; anything else is an INSTRUMENT FAILURE and the primary verdict is not evaluated
MECHANISM_GATE_checked_first.2_ple_offload_live: log contains 'PLE-offload' progress lines and VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 in the launch env; 'Available RAM' at load >= 100 GiB
MECHANISM_GATE_checked_first.4_no_restart: vllm_server_watchdog restarted the server 0 times; a restart makes the run a smoke test, not a measurement
MECHANISM_GATE_checked_first.5_the_agent_played: total decisions across 25 games >= 450 and total environment actions >= 2,000 (control 614 / 3,347; keithtyser 659 / 3,695). Below that the serving profile is starving our tree and the result is a serving finding, not a model finding
MECHANISM_GATE_checked_first.6_tool_calls_parse: 'Unknown action' deduped rejections <= 6 and malformed tool-call arguments < 5 percent of model responses

PRIMARY_VERDICT_bands_on_total_levels.crash_or_mechanism_failure: INSTRUMENT FAILURE. Fix on GCP before spending another Kaggle hour. Not a rejection of the model.
PRIMARY_VERDICT_bands_on_total_levels.<= 29: REJECT for the daily slot (the standing floor that stops a measured regression shipping). Keep the stack for the profile arms; the model is not refuted by one run inside the noise.
PRIMARY_VERDICT_bands_on_total_levels.30 to 45: TIE band. Decide on the paired sign test against the control's per_game_levels: PROMOTE into a 1:1 rotation with the incumbent if games gained >= 2 x games lost (e.g. 8 / 4), otherwise HOLD and run the GCP replicate before any slot
PRIMARY_VERDICT_bands_on_total_levels.>= 46: PROMOTE outright and ship in the next daily slot after daily_submit.sh sync. 46 is +11 over control, the same size as both prior promotions.

PRIORS_written_before_the_run.note: the instrument-failure prior is high because this is a new runtime, a new quantization kernel path on sm_120, a 135 GB model on NFS, and a PLE offload into host RAM, none of which this account has ever booted

WHAT_IS_NOT_ALLOWED: changing the metric after the numbers exist (total levels first, sign test second, means third)
reading a 33 as a win because the context window shrank (that is exactly why the two-variable caveat is written above)
spending a scored slot on GG before a completed Kaggle commit exists
DAILY_SLOT_RULE_if_promoted: GG alternates 1:1 with D-undo (the 3.15 config) until 2026-09-14, then the config with the higher mean of its draws gets 2 of every 3 slots; from 2026-10-01 only the highest measured MEAN ships (private board, mean of two auto-selected runs).
cost: build 1.5 days; GCP bring-up about 4 hours and 10 USD if quota exists; Kaggle 2.4 GPU-h per 25-game commit; first commit possible 2026-09-05 when the weekly quota resets
